wake_assessment: Frozen default bindings include ticket.*.branch.push -> rework:auto. LsRemoteTicker publishes changed ticket-branch refs after bootstrap; GithubKeys maps recognized ticket refs to these topics; listener projects matched non-command events into ExecutorWakeInbox. Pull-request synchronize separately requests reconciliation. Thus 'a push is not a wake' is false as a blanket frozen-source statement. Ref recognition, bootstrap, detector health, publication, subscription, projection, enqueue and Executor consumption remain distinct conditions; no historical delivery is proved here.
